title: SEC EDGAR Full-Text Search
description: Search the full text of every SEC filing since 2001 with EDGAR full-text search: any phrase across 10-Ks, 8-Ks, S-1s, proxies and exhibits. Returns company, CIK, form, dates, state, SIC and a direct link to the matching document.
eventDescription: One filing document matching the query
why: Find every company that said a phrase: 'going concern', 'material weakness', a supplier's name, a drug, a lawsuit. Boolean and exact-phrase queries work as on efts.
useCases: Short-sellers and credit analysts screening for distress language
Sales teams finding companies that name a technology or vendor
Lawyers and researchers tracing a term across filings

query.title: Search query
query.description: Exact phrases in double quotes. e.g. "going concern"

limits: EDGAR caps a query at 10,000 hits; narrow by form and date for more.
